arguments.question: When does Node.js 22 reach end of life?

text:
## Short answer
Node.js 22 (LTS "Jod") is supported until the end of April 2027, when it reaches end of life. Both sources agree; fairly sure.

## Sources used
- Node.js release schedule — https://nodejs.org/en/about/previous-releases
- endoflife.date: Node.js — https://endoflife.date/nodejs

## Waiting on you
none
